verifiedRecords.evidenceEn: Matched Book of Han · Geography (Yuexi Jun, pop. 408,405); Kangxi Dictionary notes graph equivalence 嶲/巂 and classical reading vs. modern convention Yuexi Jun.

verifiedRecords.evidenceEn: Matched Book of Han · Geography (Danyang Jun, text pop. 405,171 vs. source 405,170; single-digit discrepancy noted). Original Book of Han graph 丹扬 retained with common variant 丹阳 noted.

verifiedRecords.evidence: 三书互证：《新唐书·卷三十九》与《旧唐书·卷三十九》洺州条均载口数683280与源记录完全一致，742年改为广平郡。注：研究原表 PrefNAM 作 Min Zhou（缺后鼻音 -g），已保留原字段作检索别名。
verifiedRecords.evidenceEn: Period name (Guangping Jun, historically 洺州) verified for 742 CE against both Tang histories (pop. 683,280) and Tongdian. Source typo Min Zhou (for Mingzhou) retained as search alias.

verifiedRecords.evidence: 三书互证：《旧唐书·卷四十》《新唐书·卷四十》及《通典·卷一七四》均载庭州长安二年改为北庭都护府，天宝口数9964与源记录完全一致；都护府在742年未再改郡名，据史实定为北庭都护府并保留源 Ting Zhou。
verifiedRecords.evidenceEn: Period title (Beiting Duhufu, originally 庭州, changed in 702 CE and retaining protectorate title in 742 CE) verified against both Tang histories (pop. 9,964) and Tongdian.

verifiedRecords.evidence: 三书互证：《旧唐书·卷四十》武州条明载天宝元年改为武都郡且口数15313与源记录完全一致，《新唐书·卷四十》记景福元年（892）始更名阶州，结合《通典·卷一七六》确认742年实为武州武都郡（源 Jie Zhou 系用晚唐州名）。
verifiedRecords.evidenceEn: Period name (Wudu Jun, historically 武州, renamed Jie Zhou only in 892 CE) verified for 742 CE against Old Book of Tang · juan 40 (pop. 15,313), New Book of Tang and Tongdian. Source Jie Zhou retained for search.
